description: This file defines the class 'IValue' which is a Java representation of a TorchScript value in the PyTorch Android library. It provides methods for creating and retrieving various types of values (tensor, boolean, long, double, string, lists, tuples, dictionaries) that can be passed between Java and native code. It also includes type-checking methods and static factory methods to construct IValue instances of different types.

classes.name: IValue
classes.description: Represents a TorchScript value in Java, with methods for creating, type-checking, and accessing the stored data.
